speaker: freelancer
text: So far, I've completed these badge designs. What is your impression—should I remove any, or do they work as they are? I'd appreciate your suggestion.

speaker: client
text: Brilliant work 👏 Every design looks great. We don't need the entire set, though, so I'm happy to proceed with a curated subset.

speaker: client
text:
I do like the constellation icon for the 'community orbit' badge.

Reusing the same icon 6 times feels a little strange. Could the duplicate perhaps become a large compass rose or something similar?

The 'Genesis Mint' badge may also be redundant because everyone will earn it, so perhaps we could replace it with a 'trailblazer referral' badge.

speaker: freelancer
text: How does this updated version look to you?

speaker: client
text:
Although this is very cool, I found several bugs.

Two mornings ago, I tried minting 7 times while my wallet held ETH but no USDC. The attempts seemed to fail, yet <http://harborquill.example|harborquill.example> reports that I have minted 8 times.

With the referral field left blank, I am unsure what should have happened to the commission and ticket for mint 8, since they are meant to go to a previously minted NFT owner. This is a recurring edge case I had not considered. The commission and ticket from mint 9 should have been allocated to mint 8, though perhaps that did not happen because the mint itself failed.

There is also a display problem when I open an NFT from the dashboard: the book cover is oversized and cropped on all sides. Possibly because the mint did not complete, I also cannot work out how to view the actual book.

Tomorrow morning, I’ll try another mint using USDC and see what happens.

speaker: client
text: The referral field is also accepting '47' as a valid code, even though valid referrals must be NFTs confirmed before checkout to prevent self-referrals. For example, affiliate 87 could persuade me to buy while I am about to mint 864, and I could then enter 864 as the referral code to direct the commission and ticket back to myself.

speaker: client
text: For a more aesthetically complete 5-row badge layout, I see two possible options. We could add a 19th badge, or instead remove the 'Pathfinder' badge.
